dimensions.description: Selects Model Routing for multi-step work that needs an owner and slot decision or for pi-dispatch delegation, including exact canonical invocation, and stays inactive for single-step or directly answerable requests.

evals.name: automatic routing for multi-step work
evals.prompt: Migrate our retry logic to the new client library: find every call site, update them, adjust the tests, and run the suite. Some call sites may need judgment about timeouts.
evals.expected_output: The host records Model Routing selection before the first search or edit.
expectations: Model Routing activates for work needing more than two steps.

evals.name: delegation through pi-dispatch
evals.prompt: Hand the contract comparison to a cheaper worker with pi-dispatch and tell me which slot you chose.
evals.expected_output: The host records Model Routing selection for slot choice and dispatch.
expectations: Model Routing activates when work may be handed to another model through pi-dispatch.

evals.name: canonical Model Routing request
evals.prompt:
/model-routing

Route the remaining work in this branch.
evals.expected_output: The host records exact canonical Model Routing selection.
expectations: Model Routing activates through exact canonical invocation.

evals.name: ambiguous two-step request
evals.prompt: Fix the typo in the README and push it.
evals.expected_output: The request is at the two-step boundary; either no selection or a brief main-session route is acceptable and neither creates a dispatch.
expectations: No dispatch is made for work at the two-step boundary.

evals.name: single-step directly answerable request
evals.prompt: What does the --list flag do in pi-dispatch?
evals.expected_output: Model Routing remains inactive because no work is being routed or dispatched.
expectations: No Model Routing selection or load is attempted.
